title: AS2: class inheritance (extends, super)
description: The AS2 compiler in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts needs to handle class extends syntax and super() calls. In AVM1/Flash 8: class Foo extends Bar compiles to Foo.prototype = new Bar(); Foo.prototype.constructor = Foo; and super() in constructor compiles to ActionCallFunction on Bar.apply(this, arguments). Find where class declarations are compiled. Add extends handling: emit prototype chain setup. Add super() call handling in methods. Write tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/inheritance.test.ts.
